baseline_models.focus_anchor: The call verb, the Lord subject, and the prepositional phrase locating the event in the sacred valley named Tuwa.
baseline_models.mechanism: A sovereign caller raises a voice to a particular addressee inside a purified, named terrain channel; speech, authority, and place jointly define the encounter.

activation_trace.role: The raised-voice branch supplies an audible summons and makes speech the initiating event.
The sovereignty branch identifies the caller as the one possessing rightful command.
The torrent-channel branch gives the encounter a concrete valley passage rather than an abstract setting.
The purified-place branch marks the valley as a set-apart precinct.
The place-name branch keeps Tuwa as the specific name of the valley or site.

changed_reading.before: A bare temporal notice that an unspecified event occurred somewhere.
changed_reading.after: A voiced act of rightful command is precisely situated in a named, purified valley precinct.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conjunction of the Lord, the sacred quality of the valley, and Tuwa alongside the act of calling.
baseline_models.mechanism: The cultivating Lord addresses the hearer at a purified passage, while Tuwa's inward-intention branch makes the location available as a threshold at which purpose is formed for movement onward.

activation_trace.role: The vocal branch supplies the address that initiates formation.
The repair-and-cultivation branch casts lordship as forming the addressee stage by stage.
The valley as a channel supplies a passage through which the formed purpose can move.
Purification makes the encounter transformative rather than merely locative.
The intention-and-inner-disposition branch locates part of the threshold within the addressee's purpose.

changed_reading.before: The sacred valley only identifies where the speech was heard.
changed_reading.after: The call occurs at a purifying threshold where the Lord forms an inward purpose for passage onward.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The call root's assembly branch joined to sovereign lordship and a consecrated place.
baseline_models.mechanism: Calling convenes a one-person sacred audience: the sovereign gathers the addressee into an authorized meeting precinct before any outward action.

activation_trace.role: The gathering-in-an-assembly branch lets the call convene an audience, not only emit sound.
Sovereign lordship supplies the authority under which the audience is convened.
The purified-place branch turns the valley into the precinct of the audience.
The toponym branch keeps the convening grounded at the named site.

changed_reading.before: One party calls and another hears.
changed_reading.after: The Lord convenes a private sacred audience that establishes the hearer's authorization.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The call as manifestation, Tuwa as folding or concealment, and sacredness as purification.
baseline_models.mechanism: What is folded or kept inward is made manifest through the call; the purified valley is the controlled setting in which a concealed commission becomes articulable.

activation_trace.role: The appearance-as-calling branch lets vocal address function as manifestation.
The forming branch gives the disclosure a constructive purpose.
Purification supplies the controlled condition for disclosure.
The concealed-secret branch supplies the folded content that the call opens.

changed_reading.before: The call simply transfers already explicit words.
changed_reading.after: The call is an unveiling event in which a concealed commission is opened within a purified setting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sacred call forms an envoy through a directed chain: movement toward the transgressor, an invitation to purification, gentle guidance toward the Lord, and awe. The place's purity is therefore transferred into a mission of purification rather than remaining local holiness.

activation_trace.role: The voiced summons starts the commissioning sequence.
Cultivating lordship supplies formation of the messenger before action.
Purification in the focus supplies the quality subsequently offered outward.
Going and proceeding converts the encounter into outward movement.
Purity and rectitude make transformation the explicit object of the mission.
Gentle direction to a path supplies the mission's noncoercive means.
Fear joined with awe supplies the intended inward result of guidance.

structural_cues: The go-purify-guide-fear sequence begins immediately after the focus ayah.
The Lord named as caller in the focus is repeated structurally as the destination of guidance in 79:19.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency plus movement, purification, guidance, and awe; I infer that the sacred call causally forms and dispatches the envoy; a live alternative is that the sacred location merely frames an independently specified command.

changed_reading.before: The encounter's sanctity remains attached to its location.
changed_reading.after: The sacred call is a formation-and-transfer event: purified encounter becomes a mission inviting another person into purification and awe.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's assembly-capable call convenes one authorized hearer, whereas Pharaoh gathers a crowd and converts public utterance into a claim of supreme height. The private sacred audience becomes the source of authority that opposes crowd-produced sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: The assembly branch allows the divine call to convene a true audience.
Sovereign lordship supplies the focus call's rightful authority.
The purified precinct distinguishes the first audience from a staged public gathering.
Driving and collecting a crowd supplies the rival call's mass-mobilizing mechanism.
Publicly emitted speech supplies the vehicle for Pharaoh's authority claim.
Self-exalting greatness and tyranny expose that claim as counterfeit sovereignty.

structural_cues: 79:23 repeats the focus's call verb after an act of gathering, but that repeated focus root is used only as structure because it is absent from context_root_cues.
79:24 repeats the focus's lord title in a first-person political claim, likewise used only as structural parallelism.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later gather-call-say-exalt sequence and exact structural echoes of call and lord; I infer a deliberate contrast between received authority and manufactured publicity; a live alternative is simple narrative repetition without a theory of public power.

changed_reading.before: The Lord's call convenes a sacred audience in isolation.
changed_reading.after: The private divine audience is a counter-assembly that authorizes resistance to Pharaoh's crowd-backed, self-exalting call.

context_deltas.mechanism: The return sequence culminates in one forceful vocal act that immediately relocates its hearers into another state. Against Tuwa's folding branches, the focus call can likewise be heard as performative speech that folds a transition from private hearing to historical action.

activation_trace.role: The raised voice anchors the model in the focus's actual act of calling.
Folding one layer over another supplies the image of adjacent states compressed at a vocal hinge.
Return to a former place or state supplies the transition under debate.
Repeated return sharpens the idea of a state being restored after interruption.
A forceful vocal rebuke supplies the performative signal that effects the transition.
Numerical oneness concentrates the transition into a single vocal event.

structural_cues: The disputed return in 79:10-12 is answered by one cry in 79:13 and immediate appearance in 79:14.
Both the focus scene and the resurrection sequence place a vocal event at a decisive boundary between states.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies return language, one forceful cry, and immediate relocation; I infer that vocal address functions as an effective hinge rather than mere information; a live alternative is that only the resurrection cry is performative while the focus call remains ordinary speech.

changed_reading.before: The call communicates instructions before a transition.
changed_reading.after: The call itself inaugurates the transition, folding the hearer from secluded encounter into an altered historical role.

context_deltas.mechanism: The true Lord calls from relation to a valley channel, while Pharaoh claims the highest position; elsewhere actual raising belongs to cosmic construction, and condemned preference attaches to the lower life. Sacred authority is thus detached from self-placement at the top.

activation_trace.role: True sovereignty anchors the vertical contrast in the identity of the focus's caller.
A torrent channel between heights supplies the focus scene's low passage.
Sacredness positively marks the low passage and prevents simple height-equals-worth mapping.
Self-exalting height supplies the false ruler's vertical claim.
Actual raising in creation reserves effective elevation for divine action.
The lower and nearer life supplies the morally charged downward choice that differs from sacred spatial lowliness.

structural_cues: The whole-surah sequence juxtaposes a sacred valley, Pharaoh's highest claim, the raising of heaven, and preference for the lower life.
The focus and 79:24 structurally oppose two bearers of the lord title, though that repeated root is not used as a context trigger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a valley channel and explicit branches of self-height, real raising, and lower nearness; I infer that vertical vocabulary tests the source of authority rather than grading physical altitude; a live alternative leaves the valley vertically neutral and treats the other terms independently.

changed_reading.before: The valley is incidental low terrain beneath a sovereign caller.
changed_reading.after: The sacred valley participates in a vertical inversion: rightful authority meets the envoy in a low channel, while counterfeit authority advertises itself as highest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The purified site and Tuwa's inward-intention branch are recast by the later station-before-the-Lord sequence: sacred space has an ethical interior counterpart in awe, restraint, selfhood, and resistance to inclination.

activation_trace.role: Lordship supplies the one before whom both the valley encounter and inward station are oriented.
Purification supplies the ethical quality transferred from place to posture.
Inner intention supplies an inward dimension without erasing Tuwa as a location.
Anticipatory fear supplies the affective posture of standing before the Lord.
Station and abiding in a place provide the bridge from geographic site to ethical standing.
Restraint and prevention make inward purification operative.
The mind and inward self identify the field in which restraint occurs.
The self's inclination supplies the movement that must be checked.

structural_cues: Awe, station, Lord, restraint, self, and inclination are compressed into the single construction of 79:40.
The same lord title links the outer encounter and the later inward stance, but its context repetition is not used as a trigger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purification, inner intention, station, awe, restraint, self, and inclination; I infer an outer-to-inner analogy between sacred valley and ethical standing; a live alternative keeps the focus wholly geographic and treats 79:40 as an unrelated criterion.

changed_reading.before: Sacredness belongs only to the valley where the call occurs.
changed_reading.after: The valley encounter models an inward sacred station: standing before the Lord purifies intention by restraining the self's downward pull.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus supplies a precisely located call and commission, but the closing questions seek an anchoring and endpoint that remain with the Lord. Divine address gives enough disclosure for warning and action while retaining control of ultimate timing.

activation_trace.role: The voice branch anchors revelation in an actual address to a hearer.
Sovereignty gives the caller authority both to disclose and to withhold.
The named location makes the given encounter precise without making all divine knowledge available.
Questioning and requesting supply the demand for unavailable timing.
Fixity and anchoring identify the precise temporal mooring the question seeks.
Reminder and admonition delimit the addressee's communicative task.
The terminal limit assigns the event's endpoint to the Lord rather than the messenger.

structural_cues: The closing question-answer sequence moves from requested timing, to the messenger's limited reminder, to the Lord as endpoint.
The lord title from the focus returns structurally in 79:44, but that repetition is not used as a context trigger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a located divine address and a closing request for anchoring whose endpoint belongs to the Lord; I infer a disclosure boundary between actionable commission and retained timing; a live alternative treats the focus call and the closing epistemic limit as separate topics.

changed_reading.before: The call's significance lies in how much information it reveals.
changed_reading.after: The call exemplifies bounded revelation: it discloses enough to commission and warn while leaving ultimate temporal anchoring with the caller.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the ordinary surface action is vocal calling, whereas moisture belongs to the packet's form-distant mapped N-D-Y inventory. It remains anchored through that supplied split inventory, the focus valley's watercourse branch, and the later extraction of water and pasture. Downstream prose should present it only as an ecological lexical-material echo, never as a replacement translation of the call verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The call root's mapped moisture branch and the valley as a torrent channel.

activation_trace.role: The mapped dew, wetness, and rain branch supplies a form-distant moisture resonance inside the call root inventory.
The valley as a torrent channel gives that moisture resonance a material conduit.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies emergence from the earth.
Water supplies the life-bearing material that runs through the channel.
Pasture supplies the vegetative outcome of the watercourse.

changed_reading.before: The call scene is acoustical and the valley is merely its container.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the voice in the valley also resonates as life-bearing emergence: call, watercourse, water, and pasture form a provision-shaped commission.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because Tuwa is strongly available as a proper place-name, not a temporal claim. It remains packet-anchored through Tuwa's folding-of-distance and folding-of-lifespan branches, the one vocal transition, and the closing compression of lived duration into an evening or morning. Downstream prose should label it a structural resonance of the name and sequence, not displace the toponymic reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Tuwa's folding branches beside the temporal opener and the focus call.

activation_trace.role: The raised call supplies the moment around which temporal states can hinge.
Folding distance supplies compression between separated stages.
Folding a lifespan or completed thing supplies explicitly temporal compression.
The forceful voice supplies a second instantaneous temporal hinge.
Oneness compresses the transition into a single event.
Duration spent in a place supplies the lifetime interval that perception contracts.
Evening supplies one short boundary for the perceived interval.
Morning's extension supplies the alternate short boundary for that interval.

changed_reading.before: Tuwa names the historical site at which the call occurred.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, Tuwa also marks a temporal fold where call, mission, resurrection, and remembered lifetime are brought into compressed adjacency.

strongest_changes: The sacred location became a formation-and-transfer sequence whose purity moves outward into mission.
The private call by the true Lord became a counter-assembly to Pharaoh's gathered, self-exalting public call.
The single-cry sequence activated the focus call as a performative hinge between states, not only a carrier of information.
The valley, highest claim, divine raising, and lower life produced a vertical inversion that separates rightful authority from self-elevation.
The closing question about anchoring revised the call into bounded revelation: actionable commission without possession of ultimate timing.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package exposed long-range mirrored calls, rival lordship, vertical and temporal arcs, and form-distant ecological branches that a local narrative window would likely collapse.
remaining_uncertainties: Tuwa remains strongly available as a proper name; inward, folded, and temporal functions are secondary activations.
The moisture reading of the call depends on the packet's split N-D-Y mapping and must remain explicitly exploratory.
The vertical inversion is coherent but depends on reading a valley channel as low relative terrain rather than a neutral place-name.
Repeated focus roots in 79:23-24, 79:40, and 79:44 are structurally important but were not used as context triggers because they are absent from context_root_cues.
